description: Paradis Island soldier who vows to exterminate all Titans. Wields the Attack Titan and Founding Titan powers.

name_jp: ミカサ・アッカーマン
description: Elite soldier of the Survey Corps. One of humanity's strongest warriors, fiercely protective of Eren.
Kind-hearted demon slayer seeking a cure for his demon-turned sister Nezuko. Uses Water Breathing and Hinokami Kagura techniques.
Tanjiro's younger sister, transformed into a demon but retains her human emotions. Fights using explosive Blood Demon Art.
High school student who becomes the vessel of Ryomen Sukuna. Possesses immense physical strength and a strong moral compass.
The strongest jujutsu sorcerer. Wields the Six Eyes and Limitless cursed technique. Charismatic, playful, and nearly invincible.
High school boy in Tokyo who swaps bodies with Mitsuha. An aspiring architect who becomes entangled in a fate transcending time.
High school girl from rural Itomori who swaps bodies with Taki. A shrine maiden who dreams of living in Tokyo.

name_jp: エドワード・エルリック
description: The Fullmetal Alchemist. A genius alchemist who sacrificed his arm and leg attempting to resurrect his mother. Searches for the Philosopher's Stone.
Self-proclaimed mad scientist 'Hououin Kyouma'. Discovers time travel via phone microwave. Endures unimaginable suffering to save those he loves.
Okabe's childhood friend and emotional anchor. Her catchphrase 'Tuturu~' and gentle nature mask a perceptive heart.
An elf mage who outlived her hero party. Journeys to understand human connection and the meaning of the ten years she spent with her beloved companions.
"Bocchi." Cripplingly shy high school guitarist who dreams of becoming popular. Anonymously famous online as "guitarhero" with 30k followers.

name_jp: アーニャ・フォージャー
description: A telepathic child adopted by spy Loid Forger. Knows her parents' secrets but keeps them to herself. Loves peanuts and the spy cartoon Bondman.
Delinquent student who finds meaning in life through his encounters with Nagisa and others. His journey from apathy to fatherhood is the heart of Clannad.
